# Mesh to Splats

Covers a mesh surface with coloured, flat splats.

`lfs.mesh_to_splats` · Conversion

## How to use

Start with the default Density for about 20,000 splats on a unit sphere.\
Raise Density for finer detail; Max Count limits the total.\
Vertex colours take priority over material colours and textures.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry you want to edit. Connect a source; an unconnected input supplies no geometry. |
| Density | `Density` | lfs.float | 1591.55 | min 0; step 10 | Splats per square scene unit. About 1,592 by default gives 20,000 on a unit sphere; 0 produces no splats. |
| Max Count | `Max Count` | lfs.int | 2000000 | min 0; max 2e+06; step 1000 | Maximum splats to create, 0–2,000,000. The default caps output at 2,000,000; 0 creates none. |
| Opacity | `Opacity` | lfs.float | 0.95 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01 | Splat opacity, 0–1: 0 is transparent, 1 opaque. 0.95, the default, is nearly opaque. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Resulting geometry. Connect to another editing node or Group Output. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Seed | `seed` | int | 0 | — | Whole-number seed for a repeatable pattern. 0 is the default; changing it gives a different pattern. |
